name: Join a roofing crew
done: You collect your first paycheck and vanish, in the finest roofing tradition. Half a roof waves goodbye.

name: Road flagger
pitch: Hold the sign. Be the sign.
done: You spin SLOW into STOP for two days and learn what drivers think of you. One of them threw a taco.

name: Wash dishes at the diner
pitch: Pay, plus whatever's under the heat lamp.
done: You are paid in cash and a to-go sack of gravy-adjacent items.

name: Sell plasma
pitch: Your body is a side hustle.
done: You leave with cash, a juice box and a new respect for gravity.

name: Buck hay bales
done: The rancher pays you, then asks if you know anyone with a spine for hire.

name: Run a fireworks stand
done: Sales were brisk. So was the one demonstration. Eyebrows are a construct anyway.

name: Pose as an authentic cowboy
pitch: Tourists pay. Never mind your sneakers.
done: Forty strangers now believe you rope cattle. You have a rental hat and no regrets.
